reason: Nested case-control in the STRiDE cohort measures early-pregnancy blood DNA methylation and builds a CpG-based methylation risk score aimed at early risk stratification for antenatal depression.
BASE-II cohort study relates 14 DNAm clocks measured in blood to cognitive performance and decline, a prognostic outcome, across cross-sectional and longitudinal timepoints.
Explicitly a PRISMA systematic review synthesizing 11 original human studies, not primary data collection.
Described as a systematized review of longitudinal intervention studies conducted per PRISMA, not a primary study.
Human cohort with an independent validation set used blood DNA methylation array data to build and validate phenotypic-age prediction models, an epigenetic-clock development/validation study.
EWAS meta-analysis of wellbeing measures blood DNA methylation in humans but relates it only to a subjective wellbeing phenotype, not a modifiable exposure or a clinical/public health decision.
Labeled a study protocol for a planned four-arm RCT (FAXAge), describing work not yet conducted.
KADS RCT compared ketamine vs midazolam dosing paradigms and measured DNA methylation via EPIC arrays to identify treatment-response-associated CpGs in depressed patients.
HRS cohort links a data-driven dietary pattern (modifiable exposure) to deceleration of the blood DNAm-based GrimAge clock, with external validation.
ESTHER cohort longitudinally tracks DNAm-based biological age in blood and its association with all-cause mortality, a prognosis/monitoring application.
Case-control pilot study measures SDC2/TFPI2 promoter methylation in stool DNA as a non-invasive diagnostic marker for colorectal neoplasia.
Million Veteran Program EPIC-array methylation profiling with ancestry-stratified EWAS linking smoking status, a modifiable exposure, to blood DNA methylation.
Longitudinal EWAS in MESA with Framingham replication links blood DNA methylation to blood pressure traits and identifies drug-targetable loci relevant to vascular risk.
Three Spanish cohorts (case-control, longitudinal, postprandial) measure EPIC-array DNA methylation in blood in relation to ultra-processed food intake, a modifiable dietary exposure.
Extremes-of-exposure pilot design measures whole-blood DNA methylation via the TWIST methylome panel against Mediterranean diet adherence in pregnancy.
PhenoAge here is computed from nine routine clinical biomarkers and chronological age rather than from DNA methylation, so no epigenetic marker was directly measured.
NHANES cross-sectional analysis of blood DNAm-based aging biomarkers (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge2, DunedinPoAm) against one-carbon-metabolism nutrients, a modifiable exposure.
MoBa cohort sex-stratified EWAS of cord blood DNA methylation identifies CpGs associated with childhood ADHD symptoms, framed as candidate early-detection markers.
Primary colorectal tumor DNA methylation is compared between metastatic and non-metastatic pT3 cases after adjusting for tumor microenvironment composition, informing metastatic risk assessment.
Prospective cohort uses targeted bisulfite sequencing of plasma cfDNA methylation for early diagnosis and treatment-response monitoring in pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma.
Cross-sectional study in Japanese adults relates 52 lifestyle factors, a modifiable exposure, to multiple blood DNAm-based epigenetic aging indicators.
NHANES cohort derives a DNAm-based mortality score and benchmarks its incremental prognostic value against the clinical PREVENT risk model.
NHANES cross-sectional study relates smoking status, intensity, and time since cessation, a modifiable exposure, to twelve blood DNAm age biomarkers.
WHI EWAS derives stress-related blood DNA methylation risk scores validated in JHS and MESA as predictors of incident coronary heart disease.
Explicitly a PRISMA-ScR scoping review synthesizing liquid-biopsy biomarker studies rather than reporting new primary data.
Biological age acceleration is derived from the Klemera-Doubal and Light biomarker-based algorithms using routine clinical measures, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker mentioned.
Post-hoc analysis of a placebo-controlled RCT measures paired peripheral-blood DNAm clocks (PCGrimAge, PhenoAge, DunedinPACE) to show semaglutide, a drug intervention, slows epigenetic aging.
NHANES cross-sectional analysis links dietary fatty acid intake, a modifiable exposure, to blood DNA methylation-based aging biomarkers (GrimAge2, Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge).
AERIAL mother-infant cohort directly measures DNA methylation in matched amniotic and neonatal nasal tissue and links CpG sites to maternal asthma history and prenatal smoking exposure.
Case-control study profiles genome-wide cell-free DNA methylation in plasma from pancreatic cancer patients versus healthy controls for early detection and prognosis.
Retrospective cohort with paired histopathology evaluates the urinary Bladder EpiCheck DNA methylation assay's diagnostic performance and risk stratification value for urothelial carcinoma grade.
Cebu Longitudinal cohort combines six blood DNAm-based epigenetic clocks into a composite biological-age-acceleration measure and relates it to adiposity, a modifiable risk factor.

Meta-analytic mapping of age-associated DNA methylation across eight human tissues characterizes sex-moderated aging biology without linking findings to a modifiable exposure or a clinical/public health decision.

Two randomized, directly observed dosing pharmacokinetic studies of FDA-approved NRTI regimens measure DNAm-based epigenetic clocks (DunedinPACE, PhenoAge) in healthy adults, testing a drug intervention.
Early Medication Change RCT performs longitudinal EWAS in patients with major depressive disorder to identify DNA methylation changes associated with antidepressant treatment response.
Human case-control study of coal-burning fluorosis areas measures RANKL/OPG promoter methylation in participants' serum in relation to fluoride exposure, a modifiable environmental exposure.

Case-control EWAS in whole blood, meta-analyzed with PPMI and a prior cohort, identifies DNA methylation differences and a methylation-based risk score distinguishing Parkinson's disease patients from controls.
Biological age here is estimated from CT-imaging features (bone density, muscular fat infiltration, vascular calcification, visceral fat), not from any epigenetic marker.
FinnTwin12 longitudinal cohort uses exposome-wide association analysis of over 500 lifestyle and environmental exposures against blood DNAm-based epigenetic age (GrimAge, DunedinPACE).

Cross-sectional study directly measures plasma cfDNA methylation at diagnostic/prognostic loci (RASSF1, APC, MGMT, CDKN2A) in Indonesian women with lung cancer, evaluating known cancer methylation markers.
Explicitly titled 'A Study Protocol' describing a planned birth-cohort follow-up, not completed primary research.
Explicitly titled 'A Study Protocol' for a planned multi-cohort biological-ageing biomarker study.

Epigenetic age acceleration in postmenopausal women is related to the timing of natural menopause itself, which is neither a modifiable exposure/intervention nor a stated clinical or public health decision.
Multi-omic pediatric study measures pubertal DNA methylation at the VASN locus in leukocytes and links it to cardiometabolic risk factors, aimed at early stratification of obesity-related risk.
Two-cohort study of epigenetic clocks measures blood DNA methylation and relates age acceleration to smoking status and COPD severity/lung function.
ADNI cohort estimates blood DNAm age using the CausAge clock and tests its association with cognitive decline and Alzheimer's disease biomarkers, a prognostic application.
Biological age acceleration is calculated via the Klemera-Doubal method from routine clinical biomarkers in CHARLS, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic measure reported.

Case-series-with-controls study measures genome-wide DNA methylation in PBMCs of platinum-naive and platinum-resistant ovarian cancer patients enrolled in a guadecitabine clinical trial, informing treatment selection.
ESTHER cohort measures five DNAm-based principal-component epigenetic clocks in blood and tests their association with, and prediction of, type 2 diabetes risk.

DECIDER trial cohort generates whole-genome bisulfite-sequenced tumor methylomes from ovarian cancer patients and links promoter hypermethylation to chemotherapy response, supporting liquid-biopsy monitoring.
Framingham Offspring cohort measures the blood DNAm-based DunedinPACE clock and shows it predicts the rate of cognitive decline, explicitly framed for risk stratification and prognosis.

Multi-cohort epigenome-wide analysis of individual-level blood DNA methylation identifies CpGs associated with mitochondrial heteroplasmy and builds a CpG score predicting all-cause mortality and cardiovascular disease.
Biological aging in UK Biobank is measured via PhenoAge and KDM-BA computed from routine clinical biomarkers, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker mentioned.
CHARLS study combines the TyG index with Light-BA and KDM-BA, both routine-biomarker-based biological age algorithms, without measuring DNA methylation or another epigenetic mark.
Narrative review of postbiotics in psychiatry synthesizing mechanistic preclinical and human trial literature rather than reporting new primary human epigenetic data.
Multi-cohort validation study quantifies the PLAT-M8 blood DNA methylation signature by bisulphite pyrosequencing and confirms its prognostic value for overall survival after ovarian cancer relapse.
HRS Venous Blood Study computes an epigenetic-g DNA methylation score from blood and tests its association with cognitive function and incident dementia in a diverse older-adult cohort.
Case-control study in a Han Chinese population measures qMSP-based peripheral blood DNA methylation of BAX and PLAU and evaluates their diagnostic value for Alzheimer's disease.

Cross-sectional study measures ASCL1/LHX8 DNA methylation in first-void urine and evaluates its diagnostic performance for detecting high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia in an HPV-positive referral population.
BASE-II/GendAge cross-sectional and longitudinal analysis measures blood DNAm age via multiple epigenetic clocks and relates acceleration to type 2 diabetes and its complications.
Biological age here is calculated using the PhenoAge algorithm from clinical biomarkers, and the study measures OCT-based foveal imaging parameters, not any DNA methylation or epigenetic mark.
Generation Scotland study builds a blood DNA methylation EpiScore of alcohol consumption, a modifiable exposure, via elastic-net regression and validates it across four external cohorts.
Study constructs epigenetic clocks from blood methylation data in older Hispanic adults and tests association with clinical Alzheimer's diagnosis and plasma AD biomarker levels.
Explicitly a meta-analysis of four published case-control studies pooling summary effect sizes for BDNF methylation and PTSD, not new primary data.

Longitudinal placebo-controlled study measures genome-wide blood DNA methylation before and after six months of allergen-specific immunotherapy, a treatment intervention, in birch-pollen-allergic patients.

Discovery IBD cohort with 8-year follow-up, replicated in two independent cohorts, measures blood DNA methylation and epigenetic clocks (GrimAge, DunedinPACE) in relation to disease recurrence and activity.

GrimAge blood DNA methylation is related to regional cortical thickness and neuroanatomical heterogeneity, a structural imaging correlate rather than a modifiable exposure or a stated clinical/public health decision.
Sperm chromatin structure and DNA fragmentation assays measure DNA strand breakage and packaging integrity, not a regulatory epigenetic mark, per the sperm chromatin integrity exclusion rule.

Genome-wide blood DNA methylation and Mendelian randomization at TRIM61 are related to age at menarche itself, a developmental trait rather than a modifiable exposure or a stated clinical/public health decision.
G-CHF multinational heart-failure registry derives fifteen DNAm-based scores and epigenetic clocks from whole blood and tests their incremental prognostic value for hospitalization and mortality.
Shanghai Women's Health Study nested case-control evaluates DNAm-based inflammation risk scores in blood against lung cancer risk among never-smoking women.

The clock developed and measured directly in this study is built from circulating miRNAs, a non-coding RNA, which is not an eligible epigenetic marker even though it is compared to existing DNAm clocks.

TranslAGE is a harmonized resource of precomputed epigenetic biomarker scores across 179 datasets, and the abstract does not specify a single analytic design (RCT, cohort, case-control, or cross-sectional) underlying its validation claims.

The 16-week RCT develops musculoskeletal dysfunction/aging indices from inflammation, muscle-cartilage, bone turnover, cardiometabolic, and neurovascular domains, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker measured.
AERIAL/CANDLE cohort measures cord blood DNA methylation and tests whether maternal micronutrient intake buffers DNAm changes linked to prenatal air pollution exposure and childhood wheeze.
Cardiac biological age is derived entirely from an AI model applied to ECG waveforms, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker measured.
NSCLC cohort assesses epigenetic modifications via methylation BeadChips alongside SERPINB13 protein expression and correlates findings with overall survival in lung squamous cell carcinoma.
PGC-PTSD Epigenetics Workgroup meta-analyzes individual-level blood DNA methylation data regressed on PTSD diagnosis within 23 case-control cohorts before meta-analysis.

Cross-sectional study measures DNA methylation of six genes in cervical scrapes across normal-to-cancer disease severity groups and evaluates diagnostic/risk-prediction performance against standard screening tests.
Serial plasma samples from Ewing sarcoma patients undergo cfDNA methylome and fragmentome sequencing to build a classifier used for diagnosis and relapse monitoring.
Rhineland Study with EPIC-Potsdam validation measures blood DNA methylation profiles and epigenetic age acceleration in relation to ten diet quality scores, a modifiable exposure.
Secondary analysis of an RCT measures DNAm-derived BMI in preschoolers and shows it is reduced by a positive parenting intervention relative to services-as-usual.
The mortality-associated physiological axis is built from 38 routine laboratory and examination markers, not from DNA methylation or any other epigenetic measure.

Multi-institutional cohort of metastatic pancreatic cancer patients integrates circulating histone modifications and DNA methylation from plasma ctDNA into a score that informs prognostication and treatment selection.

Independent cohort of clinically diagnosed patients with recurrent embryonic malformation constellations undergoes genome-wide peripheral blood DNA methylation profiling to validate a diagnostic VACTERL episignature.
Cross-sectional study compares global peripheral blood DNA methylation between farmers exposed to pesticide mixtures, a modifiable occupational exposure, and unexposed controls.
Pilot case-control study measures plasma cell-free DNA methylation of the DUSP22 promoter by pyrosequencing and relates it to rheumatoid arthritis diagnosis and joint space narrowing.
Study uses only NSCLC cell lines in 2D versus 3D spheroid culture with no human participants or human-derived clinical samples.
Add Health national cohort measures blood DNA methylation via 16 epigenetic clocks in younger adults and relates biological aging to sociodemographic and lifestyle exposures.
Case-control training and validation cohorts measure a five-gene DNA methylation panel in plasma to build a machine-learning gastric cancer screening model.
The prognostic model is built from TCGA gene expression data for histone-phosphorylation-related genes, measuring transcript expression rather than the histone modification itself.

CALERIE2 randomized calorie-restriction trial analyzes DNA methylation data from blood alongside glycomic and transcriptomic measures to characterize aging-related changes from the dietary intervention.
TirolGESUND longitudinal intervention study measures harmonized DNA methylation across tissues in women undergoing intermittent fasting or smoking cessation, both modifiable interventions.

Crossover trial of quercetin supplementation measures sirtuin gene expression, oxidative DNA strand-break damage, and glycomics, with no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state measured.
Cohort of unscreened children with neuroblastoma has tumor DNA methylation analyzed via an epigenetic mitotic clock to estimate tumor onset timing and refine population screening windows.
NHANES cohort measures blood DNAm-based epigenetic age acceleration across five clocks and tests it as a mediator between obesity indices/weight change, a modifiable exposure, and mortality.

This cohort-profile paper describes questionnaire-based phenotyping of antidepressant response in Generation Scotland participants without measuring or reporting any DNA methylation or epigenetic marker.

Case-control study applies cell-free chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing, a chromatin-state measure, to blood from patients across the MGUS-SMM-myeloma spectrum to build a diagnostic and prognostic score.
Cohort of 763 pediatric ALL patients has array-based DNA methylation profiled to build relapse- and mortality-risk predictors, validated in two independent cohorts for risk stratification.
Italian cohort of clinically diagnosed Silver-Russell syndrome patients undergoes multi-locus and genome-wide DNA methylation testing at the H19/IGF2 locus to establish molecular diagnosis.
